talks.meetingName: 2022 Women in Compilers and Tools Meetup Series
talks.title: Python in Open Source and More with Anna
talks.abstract: Anna Ossowski discusses open-source community work, mentoring, teaching, mental health advocacy, and participation in Python-related communities.

talks.meetingName: 2022 Women in Compilers and Tools Meetup Series
talks.title: Taking the Slang Shading Language from Research to Production
talks.abstract: Theresa Foley describes taking language-design and compiler implementation research into production through the Slang shading language and compiler.

talks.meetingName: 2022 Women in Compilers and Tools Meetup Series
talks.title: Compilers Education and More with Michelle
talks.abstract: Michelle Strout answers questions about compiler education, academic paths, technical careers, and balancing career growth with life outside work.

talks.meetingName: 2022 Women in Compilers and Tools Meetup Series
talks.title: Static Profiling: Why Should You Try It?
talks.abstract: Angélica Moreira introduces software-based static profiling, static prediction using heuristics and ML, and work on the VESPA static branch predictor.

talks.meetingName: 2022 Women in Compilers and Tools Meetup Series
talks.title: User-Enhanced Learning Experience of Symbolic Logic Solving
talks.abstract: Ruanqianqian Huang and Ayana Monroe present the Online Z3 Guide and discuss teaching symbolic logic solving and SMT solver concepts.
